trip_one_star_average.reason: The Trip.com-restricted results returned generic Cape Town hotel pages and 3-star/4-star snippets, but no exact-city 1-star nightly statistic. Other-class and generic values were rejected.

hotelscombined_one_star_average.reason: HotelsCombined results reported the overall Cape Town average and 3-star or package prices, but no exact-city 1-star statistic. Overall, other-class, and package values were rejected.

budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.referencePeriod: Budget Your Trip current hotel-price analysis; 38 1-star hotels; prices before taxes and fees; result crawled last month (July 2026)
budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in Cape Town? Hotel Prices for Cape Town, South Africa | Budget Your Trip
budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.evidenceText: With data for 38 fantastic hotels, $69 is the average price for 1-star hotels in Cape Town, and the median price is $55.
budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com Cape Town South Africa 1-star hotel average nightly price
budgetyourtrip_one_star_average.reason: The Budget Your Trip result identifies Cape Town and 1-star hotels and reports a numeric average nightly price in USD. It does not state two adults and one room, so occupancy remains unknown; the separately reported median was not substituted or averaged.
